Course Description: This course introduces students to current Canadian and international economic issues with a focus on large scale economic performance and measuring economic performance, including topics in economic instability and fiscal policy, banking and monetary policy, and international trade and economic growth.Antirequisite(s): Ontario High School CIA4U or equivalent.Extra Information: 3 hours.Students are strongly advised to take Economic 0011A/B before taking Economics 0012A/B.
